posts.headline: One Nut Barner is now twenty-three straight editions into total radio silence, and this league needs to ask why a 20-8 career mark with a 1.5 average finish and zero rings has never once produced a word out of Put it in Ra's mouth.
posts.detail: A .714 win pct and back-to-back top-two finishes should come with a personality, yet Barner has let the numbers do all the talking while everyone else takes the shots.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World shows up to the draft table still needing to explain a championship banner sitting on top of a losing 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: Big Head threatens to quit the league monthly but somehow never quits collecting fluke-title erasure attempts — this draft is his chance to finally build a roster that matches the ring.

posts.kicker: CHAUNCEY'S FRESH ROSTER, SAME OLD FLOOR
posts.headline: talentedtenthh drafts from a 4-10, dead-last, 12th-place foundation, and the untalented tenth nickname is still doing more work than the actual roster.
posts.detail: An avg finish of 12.0 in his only season means there's nowhere to go but up — but this league has heard that before and seen nothing change.

posts.headline: The Ultimate Light Skin walks into another draft carrying the same cursed instincts that once led him to take a DEFENSIVE player first overall.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record and 5.5 average finish say the plagues aren't over for BIBLE OR THE BELT — Eli's got a Bible in one hand and a belt in the other, and his draft board needs both.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh drafts into yet another season and the Prince of Persia still hasn't earned a single vote of confidence from this league.
posts.detail: An 11th-place finish and a 5-9 debut record are the entire résumé — until draft night actually produces a roster worth believing in, the basement remains reserved.
